description: Rank DeFi protocols by revenue (or fees) over the last 24h, 7d or 30d, with the change versus the prior period. Answers "top DeFi protocols by 30-day revenue" and "which protocols' revenue grew most". Filter by category (e.g. "Dexs", "Lending", "Liquid Staking") and/or chain. Each row: protocol slug, category, chains, revenue for the period, prior-period revenue, percent change, 24h/7d/30d totals and all-time total (USD). Source: DefiLlama, fees and revenue dataset. Pass a returned slug to defi_protocol_fees for the daily series.

data_type.description: Rank by revenue (default) or gross fees.

sort_by.description: "value" (default) ranks by period revenue; "change" ranks by percent change vs the prior period (protocols with under $10k prior-period revenue excluded).

name: defi_revenue_ranking
title: Defi Revenue Ranking
